chapters.title: Why graph distance is not enough
chapters.question: Why can two equally small graph-edit errors have radically different causal consequences?
chapters.outcome: Explain what SHD misses and predict which graph error will damage intervention estimates more.

chapters.title: The intervention machinery
chapters.question: What must be true for an observational adjustment to reproduce an intervention distribution?
chapters.outcome: Use DAG terminology, factorization, and adjustment sets to reason about one ordered intervention pair.

chapters.title: What SID actually measures
chapters.question: Exactly when does one ordered source-target pair contribute one unit to SID?
chapters.outcome: Calculate SID pair by pair, explain its asymmetry, and normalize its symmetric variant correctly.

chapters.title: How SID is computed
chapters.question: How does the graphical definition become a matrix-and-reachability algorithm and then executable code?
chapters.outcome: Trace the paper algorithm into sid.py and distinguish its worst-case bound from observed scaling.

chapters.title: What SID guarantees—and where it stops
chapters.question: Which results justify SID, how does it extend beyond DAGs, and which claims remain limitations or open problems?
chapters.outcome: Inspect the guarantees, evaluate the simulations, and state SID's assumptions and boundaries without overclaiming.
